completed_task_history.title: deterministic paired-seed manifests
completed_task_history.scope: Add a versioned deterministic CLI manifest generator for explicit paired battle seed tuples for the pinned gen5randombattle format, with stable identifiers and pinned reference metadata; verify actual regenerated packed teams swap seats in real pinned runner battles.
exclusions: commit or push by the implementation owner
acceptance_criteria: Explicit four-limb uint16 root seed and positive pair count are required; no implicit suite size.
Versioned SHA-256 derivation over canonical [domain, root seed, pair index, stream name] JSON; digest bytes 0..7 become four big-endian uint16 limbs.
Stable pair/run identifiers are independent of requested count; base and swapped tuples exchange team and policy streams and retain battle seed.
Known vector, strict validation, byte reproducibility, prefix stability, and pinned metadata are tested.
Real pinned paired runner battles verify terminal records and exact packed-team seat exchange with policy seeds retained by identity.
Docs distinguish implemented seed manifests and team-regeneration verification from proposed benchmark workload; no throughput or generate-once claim.

Focused regressions, Trail build, state JSON parsing, and diff review pass; run Trail check and resolve substantive conflicts or document lexical false positives in the commit message per policy; no GPU required.
